meta.title: About One question daily — a daily space for reflection
meta.description: Discover what One question daily is, how the One question daily works, why public and private answers coexist, and how a small daily habit can add up over time.

hero.title: One question daily. A lifetime of reflection.
hero.subtitle: One question daily is a small, focused space where one new question appears every day, and you decide how much of your answer to share with the world.

intro.title: What is One question daily?
paragraphs: One question daily is a minimalist web application built around a simple idea: every day, a single new question appears, and everyone answers the same question at the same time.
There is no feed to scroll, no algorithm deciding what you see, and no pressure to post constantly. Just one question, once a day, for anyone who wants to stop for a moment and think.
The project started as a small personal experiment in daily journaling and has grown into a shared space where public and private reflection live side by side.

howItWorks.title: How One question daily works
howItWorks.lead: The whole experience is built around four simple steps that repeat every day.

steps.title: A new question every day
steps.description: At midnight, the question of the day changes automatically. Everyone who visits One question daily on a given day sees the exact same prompt, which keeps the experience simple and consistent.

steps.title: Answer publicly or privately
steps.description: Before you submit your answer, you choose its visibility. Public answers can be read by anyone who visits the question; private answers are only ever visible to you, even though they are saved to your account.

steps.title: Read and like other answers
steps.description: Once you have answered, you can scroll through the public answers other people left for the same question and show appreciation with a simple like.

steps.title: Revisit your own history
steps.description: Every answer you write, public or private, is saved to your personal answers page, organized by question, so you can look back on how your thinking has changed over time.

philosophy.title: Why a single One question daily?
paragraphs: Most platforms are built to maximize the time you spend on them. One question daily is designed to do the opposite: ask one meaningful question, get a short and honest answer, and let you get on with your day.

Writing a little bit, regularly, is one of the simplest habits people describe as helpful for organizing their thoughts, noticing patterns in how they feel, and remembering what mattered on a given day. One question daily tries to make that habit as frictionless as possible by removing the blank page: the question is already there, every day, waiting for you.
Because the same question is shown to everyone, answering it also becomes a small, shared ritual. You are never the only person thinking about that particular question on that particular day.

privacy.title: Public by choice, private by default control
paragraphs: Every answer on One question daily carries an explicit visibility setting that you choose before publishing it. Public answers are attached to your username and can be seen by any visitor to that question's page. Private answers are stored under your account but are never shown to anyone else, including in the answered-questions history of other users.

You can change how you answer each question independently: nothing forces you to keep the same visibility for every entry. Some days you might want to share your answer with the community; other days you might prefer to keep it just for yourself.
Answers posted without an account are treated as anonymous public answers: visible to everyone, but not linked back to a personal profile.

features.title: What you get with One question daily

items.title: One rotating question
items.description: A new question is published automatically every day, so you never have to think about what to write about.

items.title: Public or private answers
items.description: Decide, answer by answer, whether your reflection stays private or becomes part of the public conversation.

items.title: Rich text answers
items.description: Format your answers with headings, lists, links and highlights, using a distraction-free editor.

items.title: Likes on public answers
items.description: Show appreciation for answers you connect with, without leaving a comment or starting a thread.

items.title: A full question archive
items.description: Browse every past question in a calendar view, and jump straight into any day you missed.

items.title: Bilingual interface
items.description: Use One question daily in English, with more languages planned as the project grows.

community.title: A small project, built in the open
paragraphs: One question daily is an independent project, not a large company product. It is built and maintained with a strong focus on simplicity, privacy and respect for people's time.
There is no engagement-optimized notifications built into the experience. The goal is for the web to be genuinely useful for a couple of minutes a day, and then get out of your way.

items.question: Do I need an account to answer the One question daily?
items.answer: No. You can answer the question of the day without signing up, and your answer will be posted as an anonymous public answer. Creating a free account lets you choose private answers, like other people's answers, and keep a personal history of everything you've written.

items.question: How often does the question change?
items.answer: A new question is published once every day, at midnight. The same question stays active for the entire day for every visitor, and One question daily then automatically moves on to the next one.

items.question: Who can see my private answers?
items.answer: Only you. Private answers are saved to your account exactly like public ones, but they are never shown on the public question page or in anyone else's view of the archive.

items.question: Can I see questions from previous days?
items.answer: Yes. The archive page shows every past question in a calendar, so you can revisit any day and read, or answer, the question that was posted then.

items.question: Is One question daily free to use?
items.answer: Yes. Answering the One question daily, browsing the archive and reading public answers is free.

items.question: What languages is One question daily available in?
items.answer: One question daily is currently available in English, and the interface follows your preferred language automatically when possible.

items.question: Can I edit or delete an answer after posting it?
items.answer: Not at the moment: once an answer is submitted it stays as it is, so it's worth taking a moment before posting. This may change as One question daily evolves.

intro.title: Overview
intro.paragraph: One question daily is a small, independent daily-journaling application. This policy describes the personal data processed when you use the site, whether or not you create an account, and applies to every page of the service.

dataCollected.title: What data we collect
dataCollected.lead: Depending on how you use One question daily, we may process the following categories of data:

rows.value: Email address and password, managed securely through our authentication provider (Supabase Auth). We never see or store your raw password.
Username, full name and avatar URL, which you can edit at any time from your profile page.
If you sign in with Google or GitHub, we receive the basic profile information those providers share (typically your email and display name).
The text of the answers you submit, together with the visibility setting (public or private) you chose for each one.
Which public answers you have liked, so we can show your like state and the total like count.
Session cookies required to keep you signed in, and standard server logs (such as error messages) used to keep the service running.

uses.title: How we use this data
uses.lead: We use the data described above strictly to operate the service:
items: To authenticate you and keep your session active across visits.
To display your username and avatar next to your public answers.
To show you your own answer history, including private answers, on your personal pages.
To calculate and display like counts on public answers.
To detect and prevent abuse, such as spam submissions.
To communicate essential service information, such as confirming a new account.

visibility.title: Public vs. private answers
visibility.paragraph: Every answer you submit carries a visibility setting that you choose before posting. Public answers are stored with a reference to your account and are shown, together with your username, on the corresponding question page to any visitor. Private answers are stored in exactly the same database table, but our application code never returns them to any user other than their author.
visibility.note: Because visibility is enforced by our application logic and, where applicable, by database-level access rules, marking an answer as private means it is not exposed through the public pages or the public API surface of the site.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.paragraph: One question daily uses a small number of strictly necessary cookies set by our authentication provider to keep you signed in between requests. These cookies are read and refreshed by the site itself on every page load; we do not use third-party advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

thirdParties.title: Third-party services
thirdParties.lead: We rely on a small number of infrastructure providers to run One question daily:
items: Supabase — hosts our database and handles authentication, including optional sign-in with Google or GitHub.
Google and GitHub — only if you explicitly choose to sign in using one of these providers.
Our hosting provider — serves the application and may keep standard technical access logs.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.paragraph: We retain your account data and answers for as long as your account remains active. If you delete your account, your profile information and private answers are removed; public answers may be anonymized rather than deleted outright where doing so would break the context of an existing public conversation.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.lead: Depending on where you live, you may have some or all of the following rights over your data:
items: Access the personal data we hold about you.
Correct inaccurate profile information directly from your profile page.
Request deletion of your account and associated data.
Object to or restrict certain kinds of processing.
Request a copy of your data in a portable format.

minors.title: Children's privacy
minors.paragraph: One question daily is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children under the age required by applicable law in their jurisdiction. If you believe a minor has created an account, please contact us so we can remove it.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time as the product changes. Material changes will be reflected by updating the date at the top of this page.
We encourage you to review this page periodically to stay informed about how we handle your data.

contact.title: Contact
contact.paragraph: If you have questions about this policy or wish to exercise any of your rights, please reach out through the contact channel listed on our site.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.subtitle: Everything you might want to know about how One question daily works, grouped by topic. Can't find your answer here? Check the how it works page for more detail.

items.question: What is One question daily?
items.answer: A minimalist daily journaling web: one new question is published every day, and anyone can answer it, publicly or privately.

items.question: Is One question daily free?
items.answer: Yes. Reading questions, answering them and browsing public answers is completely free.

items.question: Do I need to install anything?
items.answer: No, One question daily runs entirely in your browser, on desktop or mobile, with no web to install.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: The interface is currently available in English, and follows your browser or account language preference automatically.

items.question: Do I need an account to answer the One question daily?
items.answer: No. You can submit a public answer anonymously. Creating a free account additionally lets you post private answers, like other answers and keep a personal history.

items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: Use the sign-up page with your email and a password, or continue directly with Google or GitHub.

items.question: I forgot my password, what do I do?
items.answer: Use the login form's password recovery option, if enabled, or sign in with the same OAuth provider you originally used to create your account.

items.question: Can I change my username later?
items.answer: Yes, you can update your username and full name at any time from your profile page.

items.question: How do I delete my account?
items.answer: Contact us through the channel listed on the site so we can process the deletion of your account and associated private data.

items.question: How often does a new question appear?
items.answer: A new question is published once per day, at midnight, and stays the same for every visitor until the next day begins.

items.question: Can I answer more than once to the same question?
items.answer: Yes, there is no limit on the number of answers you can submit to a single question, each with its own visibility setting.

items.question: Can I edit an answer after posting it?
items.answer: Not currently. Once an answer is submitted, it is saved as written, so it's worth reviewing it before you post.

items.question: What kind of formatting can I use in my answer?
items.answer: The answer editor supports headings, bold, italics, lists, quotes, links, highlights and code blocks.

items.question: Can I see questions from previous days?
items.answer: Yes, the archive page shows every past question in a calendar you can browse freely.

items.question: Who can see a private answer?
items.answer: Only you. Private answers never appear on the public question page or in anyone else's view of the archive.

items.question: Can I change an answer from public to private afterwards?
items.answer: Not at the moment, since answers cannot currently be edited after submission. Choose the visibility carefully before posting.

items.question: Does One question daily sell my data?
items.answer: No. We do not sell personal data to third parties. See our privacy policy for full details.

items.question: Are anonymous answers really anonymous?
items.answer: Yes, answers submitted without an account are not linked to any profile and are shown simply as anonymous public answers.

items.question: What does the like button do?
items.answer: It lets you show appreciation for a public answer. The like count updates for everyone viewing that answer.

items.question: Can I like a private answer?
items.answer: No, likes are only available on public answers, since private answers are only ever visible to their author.

items.question: Can I remove a like I gave?
items.answer: Yes, clicking the like button again removes your like and updates the count immediately.

hero.title: How One question daily works, step by step
hero.subtitle: A closer look at what happens behind the scenes every time you open the app, answer a question, or like someone else's reflection.

lifecycle.title: The lifecycle of a question
lifecycle.lead: Every question published on One question daily goes through the same simple lifecycle.

steps.title: One question is scheduled per day
steps.description: Each question in our archive has an assigned display date. Only the question whose date matches today is shown as the active question.

steps.title: It becomes active at midnight
steps.description: As soon as a new day starts, the previous question is retired to the archive and the next scheduled question becomes the one everyone answers.

steps.title: Everyone sees the same prompt
steps.description: There is no personalization involved: every visitor, logged in or not, sees the exact same question for the day.

steps.title: It moves to the permanent archive
steps.description: Once a question's day is over, it remains permanently browsable in the archive, along with every public answer it received.

timeline.title: A day in the life of a question
timeline.lead: Here is what typically happens over the course of a single day.

items.title: The question changes
items.description: The countdown on the home page resets and the new question of the day is displayed to every visitor.

items.title: First answers arrive
items.description: Visitors start submitting their answers, choosing between public and private visibility for each one.

items.title: Public answers accumulate
items.description: Public answers appear in real time under the question, and other visitors can like the ones that resonate with them.

items.title: The countdown reaches zero
items.description: The home page's live countdown reaches zero, and the question quietly moves into the archive as the next one takes its place.

answering.title: What happens when you submit an answer
answering.lead: Submitting an answer involves a few explicit, transparent steps.

steps.title: Write your answer
steps.description: Use the rich text editor to write your reflection, with support for headings, lists, links and basic formatting.

steps.title: Choose public or private
steps.description: Registered users see a visibility switch; leaving it off keeps the answer public, turning it on keeps it private and visible only to you.

steps.title: Submit the answer
steps.description: The answer is validated and saved against the current question and, if you are logged in, against your account.

steps.title: See it appear instantly
steps.description: If your answer is public, it appears immediately in the answers list below the question, without needing to refresh the page.

likes.title: How likes work
paragraphs: Only public answers can receive likes, since private answers are never shown to anyone but their author.
When you like an answer, that preference is recorded against your account and the answer, and the total count shown to everyone updates immediately.

You can remove your like at any time by clicking the button again; the count is always recalculated from the underlying like records, so it stays accurate even if you like and unlike an answer repeatedly.

archive.title: The question archive and calendar
paragraphs: Every question that has ever been active is kept permanently in the archive, accessible from a calendar view organized by month.
Tomorrow's question is always shown as locked, with a live countdown until it unlocks at midnight, so you can never see a question before its day arrives.
On mobile, the same information is available through a simplified day-by-day and list view, designed for smaller screens.

accounts.title: Accounts and sign-in options
paragraphs: You can use One question daily fully anonymously for public answers, or create a free account using your email and a password.
Accounts can also be created or accessed instantly using Google or GitHub sign-in, without needing to remember a separate password.
Once logged in, your profile page lets you update your username and full name, which are shown next to your public answers.
